bias.zh: 回调 · 跌破 100 日均线，守住 200 日均线

read.en: Amazon fell 4.1% on Nov 20 to $246.82, its lowest close since Nov 2, trading $245.31–259.97 on above-average volume (1.44x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($257.5, falling), 10-day ($262.6), 30-day ($257.0) and 100-day ($255.1), all rising, and holds just above the rising 200-day ($245.2). MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 20, above zero; Parabolic SAR turned bearish the same day ($275.34), and RSI is 42.3.
read.zh: 亚马逊 11月20日下跌 4.1%，收于 $246.82，为 11月2日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $245.31–259.97，成交量高于均值（为 20 日均量的 1.44 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$257.5，下行）、10 日（$262.6）、30 日（$257.0）和 100 日均线（$255.1）下方，后三者均在上行，仅守在上行的 200 日均线（$245.2）上方。MACD 于 11月20日下穿信号线，在零轴上方；抛物线 SAR 同日转为看空（$275.34），RSI 为 42.3。

read.en: The close broke the $251–255.5 supports (100-day, Nov 5 low), now resistance, and is testing the $244.3–246.5 zone (200-day, Sep and Oct lows). Resistance is $249.5–252, then $255–257.5 (100-, 30- and 5-day) and $262.6 (10-day). Support is $244.3–246.5, then $239 and $229.4 (Oct 30 low). A close above $252 would target $255–257.5; below $244.3, $239.
